summary.text: Patty Lewis, a Democrat, represents Missouri Senate District 7, part of Jackson County; she was elected in November 2024.
She previously served two terms in the Missouri House of Representatives and has more than 20 years of health care experience as an ICU nurse and health care executive.

paragraphs.text: Lewis worked as an ICU/Critical Care Registered Nurse and, as an executive, led teams working to improve patient safety for health care organizations across the world.
She volunteers with local organizations and serves on various community boards.
Lewis was born and raised in Kansas City and lives there with her husband.
